sentences.japanese: 一番最初に見るのはスポーツ欄だよ。
sentences.english: I always read the sports page first.

sentences.japanese: ああそうそう、コメント欄のバグは文字間を調節するletter-spacingタグを使うと起こるものだったみたい。
sentences.english: Oh, while I remember, it seems that that was a bug that occurs when you use the comment field's 'letter-spacing' tag which adjusts the tracking.

sentences.japanese: ※印の欄には記入しないでください。
sentences.english: Please do not fill in fields marked with *.

sentences.japanese: あ、郵便番号の欄に電話番号書いちゃった。
sentences.english: Oh, I've mistakenly written the telephone number where I should've put the postcode.

sentences.japanese: 括弧は使わず、補足情報はコメント欄にてご対応ください。必要に応じて、2文を追加することもできます。
sentences.english: Please do not use parentheses, but provide any supplementary information in the comments section. If necessary, two sentences may be added.
